bets.event: KT Rolster Challengers vs DN SOOPers Challengers — Game 1
bets.settlementBasis: DN SOOPers Challengers wins if its final kill total is no more than 4 below KT Rolster Challengers; loses only if KT.C finishes at least 5 kills ahead.
bets.result: KT Rolster Challengers won Game 1 with a final kill score of 26-7; DN SOOPers Challengers +4.5 kills lost by an adjusted margin of 14.5 kills.
bets.seriesState: Series 0-0 before Game 1; KT Rolster Challengers led the series 1-0 after settlement.
bets.entryState: Post-draft, before the first meaningful Game 1 event; no intervening game action reported between recommendation and execution.

modelRecommendation.reasoning: Near-even team-strength prior. DNS had simpler Skarner-Alistar initiation, Rumble zone control and Sivir wave-clear, which the model treated as credible kill-trading and margin protection against KT's red-side composition.

execution.priceMoveClassification: favorable price-only move with no reported meaningful game event

review.resultAssessment: The wager lost because KT.C won the final kill score 26-7, a 19-kill margin. DNS.C finished 14,000 gold behind and lost towers 10-2.
review.processAssessment: Draft-evaluation error. The model correctly identified DNS.C's initiation tools but incorrectly treated initiation quality as sufficient evidence of kill-trading. DNS.C repeatedly produced setups without reliable follow-up damage, while KT.C had durable frontline, protection, disruption and superior sustained damage through Cassiopeia. Sivir wave-clear improved map survival but did not guarantee champion damage conversion into K'Sante-Shen frontline or during separated engages.
review.ruleUpdate: LoL model v0.3.3 adds an engage-to-damage conversion gate. Positive kill handicaps now require verified follow-up timing, at least two credible damage sources, target access, frontline kill speed and sustained damage after the initial control chain. Engage and wave-clear alone cannot qualify as kill-trading evidence.

bets.notes: User confirmed the final Game 1 state: KT Rolster Challengers won 26-7 in kills in 33:35, with 70.5k-56.5k gold and 10-2 towers. DN SOOPers Challengers +4.5 kills at 1.806 for 0.25u (125,000 VND), slip #1148296192, lost. Payout 0 VND and net loss 125,000 VND (-0.25u). The user observed that DNS.C could create setups but lacked damage follow-up, including later stages. The review classifies this as a synchronized execution with a model draft-evaluation error, not an execution deviation. This is confirmed LoL wager #15 since the dedicated chat began on 2026-07-29.
